description: Geometry-based planning preference; center penalties are stronger for flower and large-leaf interiors. Values are not measured stiffness.
uncertainty_rule: For each resolved leaf/flower, apply one multiplier 1 + (class uncertainty multiplier - 1) * uncertain surface area fraction to the whole organ; retain original point uncertainty flags.
center_rule: leaf: 1 + leaf_center_gain * center_score ** center_power; flower: 1 + flower_center_gain * center_score ** center_power
unresolved_fragment_rule: use maximum center and size multiplier, never treat an unresolved patch as free space
